name: No Way Out
tagline: Combine multiple sensory facts to escape a dead end.
narrative:
This 7x7 maze introduces a tricky dead end.

Your robot's simple rules know how to walk forward and turn right at corners, but in a dead end surrounded by walls on multiple sides, turning right just spins the robot in circles.

To break out, combine two facts into a specific rule: when there is a wall ahead AND a wall to the right, turn left instead. Place this specific rule above the general turn-right rule so it triggers before the fallback!
objective: Navigate the 7×7 maze, reach the goal, and hold there for 3 consecutive ticks.
learningObjective: Combine conditions with AND (&&) and order specific rules above general fallbacks.
intelligenceExplanation:
General rules like `wallAhead -> pivot-right` fail when trapped because they keep repeating the same turn.

By checking `wallAhead && wallRight`, you create a rule specific to dead ends. Rules are checked top-to-bottom, so specific cases must sit above general fallbacks.
hint: Create a rule: WHEN wallAhead && wallRight -> DO pivot-left, and place it above the general wallAhead rule.
hints: A general turn-right rule spins endlessly in a dead end.
Combine two facts: WHEN wallAhead AND wallRight -> DO pivot-left.
Order rules: 1) atGoal -> hold, 2) wallAhead && wallRight -> pivot-left, 3) wallAhead -> pivot-right, 4) !wallAhead -> step.
brief: Recognize dead ends with combined AND conditions and escape to the goal.
context: The maze has a dead-end pocket. A simple turn-right rule loops indefinitely when trapped.
